title: Classification Problem Example: Input and Output Shapes

cues.en: Welcome back.

cues.en: In this case, the inputs.
cues.zh: 這裡的輸入，

cues.en: And in the case of Food Vision, we want to know, okay, this is a photo of sushi and this is a photo of steak and this is a photo of pizza.
cues.zh: 以 Food Vision 為例，我們要知道，這張是壽司照片，這張是牛排，這張是披薩。

cues.en: You can get more hands on and technical and complicated, but we're just going to stick with single label multiclass classification.
cues.zh: 可以做得更深入、更技術性、更複雜，不過我們先只做單一標籤的多類別分類。

cues.en: So how might we numerically represent these photos?
cues.zh: 那如何用數值表示這些照片？

cues.zh: 假設應用程式有個功能，每張拍下的照片都自動縮放成正方形，寬 224、高 224。

cues.en: This is actually quite a common dimensionality for computer vision problems.
cues.zh: 這其實是電腦視覺問題中很常見的尺寸。

cues.en: And so we've got the width dimension, we've got the height, and then we've got this sea here which isn't immediately recognisable.
cues.zh: 所以有寬度維度、高度維度，還有這裡一個不那麼直觀的 C。

cues.en: But in the case of pictures, they often get represented by width, height, colour channels and the colour channels is red, green and blue, which is each pixel in.
cues.zh: 圖片通常以寬度、高度與色彩通道來表示；色彩通道是紅、綠、藍，也就是

cues.zh: 這張圖片的每個像素，都有一些紅、綠、藍的數值，組合出這裡顯示的顏色。

cues.en: And this is one way that we can numerically represent an image by taking its width, its height and colour channels and whatever number makes up this particular image.
cues.zh: 這是把圖片表示成數值的一種方法，使用寬度、高度、色彩通道，以及組成特定圖片的數字。

cues.en: We're going to see this later on when we work with computer vision problems.
cues.zh: 之後處理電腦視覺問題時會看到。

cues.en: So we create a numerical encoding which is the pixel values here.
cues.zh: 所以建立數值編碼，就是這裡的像素值。

cues.en: Now we input the pixel values of each of these images into a machine learning algorithm, which is often already exists.
cues.zh: 再把每張圖片的像素值輸入機器學習演算法，而演算法往往已經存在。

cues.en: And if it doesn't exist for our particular problem, hey, well, we're learning the skills to build them now.

cues.zh: 這裡是預測機率，機器學習模型的輸出其實從來不是離散的，不會說「這絕對是披薩」。

cues.zh: 這張可能判斷錯了，不過增加訓練與資料後，應該能改善預測。
